content.title: Natural Theology (1802)
content.author: William Paley
content.note: The watchmaker argument from design, which Hume's critique preceded and Darwin later answered. For the design argument in its own classic form. publicDomain.edition: Natural Theology, by William Paley, with notes by John Ware (New York: Sheldon & Company, 1879; the Internet Archive scan naturaltheologyo00pale)
publicDomain.basis: Paley's text was first published in 1802; the held scan is the American edition with John Ware's notes, entered for copyright in 1854 and printed in 1879 (title page). Paley died in 1805 and Ware in 1864: public domain in the US and worldwide. Extracts quote Paley's own text, not Ware's notes.
